subject: HackWeave maintainers support request — compute top-up & trial extension
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@hackweave.org>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: HackWeave maintainer support (compute top-up + short trial)

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the chat last week — HackWeave is shaping up and we have a handful of community maintainers who are short on compute for mentor hours and on-site demos. We ran a quick budget and would like to request a small top-up and a short trial extension for eligible maintainers.

What we are asking for:
- 3,000 compute credits to split across 6 maintainers (preference to those mentoring in-person)
- 14-day trial extension for any maintainer who is currently in a trial window (we expect ~10 folks)

Attached is a CSV with the maintainer list and quick bios. If you need a formal sponsorship blurb or logos, happy to provide. Ideal delivery: credits allocated by Jan 22 so mentors can prepare.

Open to next steps — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Operations, HackWeave
Attachments: hackweave-maintainer-list.csv
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@hackweave.org>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: HackWeave maintainer support (compute top-up + short trial)

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Samira's ask. High level: HackWeave wants a small pool of credits + trial extensions for maintainers who will be mentoring at the event. They aim to split ~3k credits across 6 maintainers and want allocation by Jan 22.

Questions for approval:
- Is 3k (one-off hosted credits) okay from program budget?
- If not, would a combo of 2k credits + 14-day trial extension be acceptable?
- Any required comms / sponsor terms we should send them (they asked for a blurb)?

I've attached the maintainer list for context. If you both sign off, I can confirm and open a HubSpot deal for tracking.

Best,
Mateo
Account Lead, Community Programs
Redwood Inference

--- Forwarded attachment: hackweave-maintainer-list.csv (6 rows) ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Samira Khan <samira@hackweave.org>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: HackWeave maintainer support (compute top-up + short trial)

Thanks for sending, Mateo. Appreciate the quick context, Samira.

We can support community mentor stipends via the program budget but would prefer a modest top-up: 3,000 seems fine, but can we allocate 2,000 in hosted credits and offer the 14-day trial extension to the remaining folks? That reduces immediate spend and still covers mentor needs.

Requesting the following to proceed:
- A short MoU / sponsor terms (1 page) listing the deliverables (logo placement, short thank-you blurb, social handle). I'll draft a sponsorship-draft.pdf and attach for you to review — can you confirm it matches HackWeave's needs?
- Confirmation on preferred credit recipients (from the CSV) and whether any maintainers are on enterprise accounts (which would change how credits are applied).

If everything checks out I'll approve the 2k hosted credits today and we can push the trial extension as a programmatic gesture.

Marissa Cole
Community Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: sponsorship-draft.pdf

> On Thu, Jan 14, 2027 at 10:03 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Samira's ask. High level: HackWeave wants a small pool of credits + trial extensions for maintainers who will be mentoring at the event.
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, Samira Khan <samira@hackweave.org>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: HackWeave maintainer support (compute top-up + short trial)

Thanks — agree with Marissa's approach. Quick operational notes:
- I'll route the 2,000 hosted credits through the Community Grants SKU and set the allocations per the CSV (Mateo, please confirm final emails).
- For the trial extension: we should provide a 14-day trial coupon token per maintainer rather than retroactive extensions; easier to track and avoids entitlements on enterprise plans.
- I'll create a HubSpot deal (HW-2027-4432) and link a DocuSign for the one-page MoU. Samira, expect a DocuSign to sign (non-binding sponsor terms) — once signed we can push credits same day.

Samira — proceeding on the assumption you sign the sponsorship-draft.pdf. If any maintainer is on an enterprise contract, flag them and I'll coordinate a billing exception.

Next steps:
1) Samira to review & sign sponsorship-draft.pdf (DocuSign link will come from me)
2) Mateo to confirm final maintainer emails for allocations
3) Karthik to push 2,000 credits + issue 14-day coupon tokens

Karthik Iyer
Head of Partner Programs
Redwood Inference
